secant-line.def: A line through two points $(a, f(a))$ and $(b, f(b))$ of a graph. Its slope, $\frac{f(b) - f(a)}{b - a}$, is the average rate of change of $f$ on $[a, b]$.

second-differences.def: For outputs at equal input steps, the changes in the first differences (the changes in output). Constant second differences mean the values fit a quadratic function.
